title: Koode Sappo e Go’o ɗe Suuɗii
intro: Limngal ummoraade e Qur’aana hokkaama yi’annde luggiɗnde e nder cukaagu mum — koyɗol ɓalli asamaan ina cujjana e teddungal. Duuɓi ina njahra e janfa, e seertude, e tuumeede fenaande, e kasoo hade ndee yi’annde waɗde goonga. Hol oo ruuhu cemmbinɗo mo daartol mum jogori huutoraade tonngoode ɓurnde juutde e Quraana?
clues: Miɗo wonnoo suka, barkinaaɗo e koyɗol kaawningol ngol hay baaba am jeertini mi yo mi resndu.
Banndiraaɓe am, wumɓe e kaaɗdi, mbaɗi feere ngam haɓaade mi, mberlii kam e nder ɓuuɓri luggiɗndi, niɓɓiri.
Mi nawtaa leydi woɗɗundi, mi yeeytaa e galle jaagorde teddunde, ɗo keɓ-mi moƴƴere, mi ummii e golle.
Tuumeede fenaande addani mi kasoo tawa ko e dow fenaande, kono e nder oon nokku niɓɓo mi heɓi cuusal e duwaawu e sujjande Alla.
Alla barkinii kam mbaawka firo koyɗi ɗi keewaani, ɗi ngaddani mi yeeso laamɗo leydi ndii, ɗi toowni mi e darnde toownde e hoolaare.
Caggal duuɓi juutɗi ceertuɗi, mi hawri e galle am giɗo, koyɗol am cukaagu am, koode sappo e go’o, naange, e lewru ina cujjana mi, haa laaɓi cer.

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِى ٱشْتَرَىٰهُ مِن مِّصْرَ لِٱمْرَأَتِهِۦٓ أَكْرِمِى مَثْوَىٰهُ عَسَىٰٓ أَن يَنفَعَنَآ أَوْ نَتَّخِذَهُۥ وَلَدًۭا ۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ مَكَّنَّا لِيُوسُفَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلِنُعَلِّمَهُۥ مِن تَأْوِيلِ ٱلْأَحَادِيثِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَالِبٌ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرِهِۦ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And the one from Egypt who bought him said to his wife, "Make his residence comfortable. Perhaps he will benefit us, or we will adopt him as a son." And thus, We established Joseph in the land that We might teach him the interpretation of events [i.e., dreams]. And Allāh is predominant over His affair, but most of the people do not know. (12:21)
